The Singer trace-plane construction yields q+1 residue classes with every nonzero difference once, while r(r-1)+1≥q²+q+1 forces r≥q+1. All infinite steps are algebraic; verify.py finite checks agree.

An infinite family of degrees n=q²+q+1 now has a sharp explicit threshold q+1; the earlier general sufficient threshold is >n/2.
